Skill `vercel-deploy`.
Roles: `agent`, `user`.
Tool `check_vercel_cli` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `shell`; adds `vercel_cli_installed`.
Tool `deploy_with_vercel_preview` (owner `agent`): via `windows_desktop`; needs `vercel_account`; adds `preview_deployed`, `deployment_url_known`.
Tool `deploy_with_vercel_production` (owner `agent`): via `windows_desktop`; needs `vercel_account`; adds `production_deployed`, `deployment_url_known`.
Tool `deploy_with_fallback_script` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `local_filesystem`; adds `preview_deployed`, `deployment_url_known`, `claim_url_known`.
Tool `ask_for_escalation_consent` (owner `agent`): via `ask_user`; adds `escalation_answered`.
Initially true: `shell`, `local_filesystem`, `user_conversation`.
Goal: `deployment_url_known` and ( `preview_deployed` or `production_deployed` ) and ( `production_requested` or not `production_deployed` ).
Protocol:
  - `agent` uses `check_vercel_cli`.
  - `user` chooses one of (observed):
    - branch `production_requested`:
      - `agent` uses `deploy_with_vercel_production`.
    - branch `preview_requested`:
      - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
        - branch `cli_available_and_authenticated`:
          - `agent` uses `deploy_with_vercel_preview`.
        - branch `cli_missing_or_auth_failed`:
          - `agent` uses `deploy_with_fallback_script`.
        - branch `network_blocked_needs_escalation`:
          - `agent` uses `ask_for_escalation_consent`.
          - `user` chooses one of (observed):
            - branch `consent_given`:
              - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
                - branch `cli_path`:
                  - `agent` uses `deploy_with_vercel_preview`.
                - branch `fallback_path`:
                  - `agent` uses `deploy_with_fallback_script`.
            - branch `consent_denied`: none.
